subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de2a3639449e916185766f43b813a8b3ed7d079c09210457d92a0ceefb35785f.png]
solution:
In the following figure, we need to observe the **4 different kinds of patterns,** which are running through each figure.**​**

__
 
• **Pattern of circle**__** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7740926cd80aec8488cf1c26b4e308634dc153e4862274fea19866f7dc97dbe7.png] **:** In the consecutive boxes the circle is transferred to the consecutive corner in a clockwise manner, **Thus, in the following box the circle will be in the upper left corner.**

**​ ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7777b606e167ea1d3f83f14000102d0a854dfbcbf743eb191f123adf898d7079.png] 

__
 
• **Pattern of arrow**__** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/632058802dcccc5ff3a03b9abd91802162c1d11546bf5a668c5ca69154713ad2.png] **:** In each consecutive box, the direction of the arrow changes in an anticlockwise manner. **Thus, in the following box, the arrow will face downwards.**

**​ ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92ff49e85e51a6aab3aa31150f54b3976eab19fdfc053b1d910cbb4969cc59fc.png] 

__
 
• **Pattern of star**__** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a8702f89801a443ba04d5fa3cfabd4683d60f3a97eef9476d4a382b7f8fc4f9.png] **:** In each consecutive box, the star is moving diagonally upwards and then coming back to its origin diagonally. **Thus, in the following box the star will be placed at the lower left corner. **

**​ ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6f8dbcfe4ddb0930fccc7beeaadf010cfa8b78dfc271a844ff750a19d77a451.png] 

__
 
• Pattern of color:__ In consecutive boxes, one box has black colored star, whereas in the next box the arrow and circle are black colored. Thus, in the following box the star will be black colored, and the arrow and circle will not be colored.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a8247def63cf47e0288d6e553fdda1d27d1d5126ef1a8db4f35b2c8aca67ee.png] 

 
• Thus, the following box will contain the pattern made in **Option 4**.

** Hence, the correct answer is*** **"Option 4"*****.**
